explanation: A projectile launched horizontally keeps a constant sideways velocity while gravity acts only downward, so the horizontal and vertical motions are completely independent. The green arrow (vx) never changes length, but the violet arrow (vy) grows as it falls, and the two combine into a parabola. The fall time depends ONLY on the drop height h0, so raising v0 lengthens the range but never changes how long it stays in the air.
bullets: Horizontal velocity is constant; vertical velocity grows like free fall.
Time aloft depends only on height h0, not on launch speed v0.
Range = v0 * sqrt(2 h0 / g): faster launch reaches farther.
